beats_top.query: cornell off campus jobs ithaca students part time
beats_top.why: The #1 result is the official Community Work-Study page, which covers only one route and says nothing about hotels, Collegetown, tutoring, pay levels, buses or F-1 limits. Our first paragraph answers the question and sends the reader by situation, with dated Chamber pay figures, a transit plan and the CPT rules.
